brief.audience: Families and adults choosing a general dental practice
brief.primaryAction: Read care information and request a visit after configuring a destination
brief.content: Six-page Linden Dental A2 site. No invented provider names, credentials, results, address or availability. Contact form is unconfigured.
brief.imagery: Nine user-approved generated photographs used once each across the site; exact L2 logo and mark. Sky/Ice palette, Figtree and Source Sans 3.

provenance.license: User-approved generated artwork and original vector logo; approval hashes retained with private brand records.

findings.detail: Private site review candidate. Complete-site approval, full promotion ledger, broader native editing exercises and host-specific responsive matrix remain release gates. Existing concept/asset approvals are in the private Site Studio run and must be migrated with exact evidence before promotion.
findings.correction: Complete required release checks and exact-package approval before catalog promotion. See evidence/template-authoring-2026-11-12/dental/package/compatibility.json for completed checks and limits.
